title: MV Help Needed: Changing Image Opacity on Hover in MV

posts.author: Lobster_Lord
posts.body: Hello folks, first-time poster here. I know nothing about Java Script, so I thought I could ask for help here. I am currently making a game in MV where, for one particular minigame, I need the player to be able to hover over an image, and when they do, it should set the opacity from 0% to 100%. Is there any way to do that with scripts or plugins? I have messed around with some AI-generated stuff (it's stupid, I know, but I can't code), but that has not worked at all, and I am getting a lot of errors that break the game. Any advice or help would be very much appreciated!
